description: Zigzag-reads the source at a given FREQUENCY around a movable LOCATION: at frq Hz the read head sweeps srate/(2*frq) samples forward then the same back, over and over, from the point 'loc' - sustaining one moment of the sound as a pitched, breathing oscillation. Duration set_by dur with small grid overshoot (+0.5% at dur 3, +1.2% at dur 2 - the zigzag completes its cycle). BREAKPOINTS (each verified distinct from both scalar endpoints): frq, loc, frqrand AND locrand are all time-variable through OUTPUT time (banner-confirmed 'time in any brkpoint files is time in output-file') - a loc ramp scrubs the read point through the source, a frq ramp glisses the zigzag rate; splice and dur refuse verbatim (parameters 5/6). RANDOMISATION IS FIXED-SEQUENCE (first-class): frqrand/locrand > 0 change the render but two unseeded runs 1.3 s apart are BYTE-IDENTICAL - there is no seed slot and no clock path (the osbind drand48 shim runs from rand()'s default seed; shrink/sfecho family behavior), so 'random' takes are always the same take: version_sensitive. MONO ONLY ('File swp2st.wav is not of correct type (must be mono)'). Ranges verbatim: frq '(0.250000 to 22050.000000)' (ceiling = Nyquist, input-dependent); loc 0 to input duration ('Parameter[2] Value (2.500000) out of range (0.000000 to 2.000000)'); frqrand/locrand 0-1; splice must be < 1/(2*max frq) ('ERROR: Splicelen incompatible with maximum frequency: must be less than 2.494331 mS' at frq 200). Deterministic base verified byte-identical.
musical_use: The scrub-freeze: park the read head on a vowel, a chord, a texture-moment and it HOVERS there for as long as you like - but unlike a loop-freeze the zigzag rate is itself a pitch, so the frozen moment acquires a fundamental at frq Hz. Low frq (0.5-5 Hz) reads as slow back-and-forth scrubbing (audible sweep, tape-rock); mid frq (20-100) fuses into a gravelly drone whose pitch you PLAY with a frq breakpoint (melodies on a frozen timbre); the source content colors the tone. loc breakpoints traverse the file - a slow 0 -> indur ramp is the classic time-smeared scan of a phrase. locrand blurs the location (thicker, phasier), frqrand roughens the pitch - both are repeatable-only (fixed random sequence, no seed to vary; re-render with slightly different params for a 'new take'). Keep splice small (1-3 ms) at high frq (hard ceiling 1/(2*frq)). Compare hover2: zero-crossing-locked symmetric waveforms, cleaner and more synthetic - hover keeps more of the source's grain.

frq.description: Zigzag read rate in Hz: each cycle reads srate/(2*frq) samples forward then back, so frq is heard as a fundamental once above ~20 Hz. CDP-enforced 0.25 to Nyquist ('(0.250000 to 22050.000000)', input-dependent ceiling). Breakpoint-capable through output time (verified: brk render and length distinct from both endpoints).

loc.description: Source time from which samples are read (0 to input duration, refusal verbatim - input-dependent). Breakpoint-capable through output time (verified distinct from both endpoints) - ramp it to scrub through the file.

frqrand.description: Random variation of frq, 0-1 (CDP-enforced verbatim). Changes render AND length slightly, but the random sequence is FIXED (unseeded pairs byte-identical - no seed exists). Breakpoint-capable (verified distinct from both endpoints).

locrand.description: Random variation of the read location, 0-1 (CDP-enforced verbatim). Fixed-sequence like frqrand. Breakpoint-capable (verified distinct from both endpoints).

splice.description: Splice length at zig/zag ends, ms. Runtime ceiling 1/(2*max frq) seconds ('must be less than 2.494331 mS' verbatim at frq 200 - frq-dependent). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 5').

dur.description: Total output duration; actual output overshoots slightly to complete the zigzag grid (+0.5-1.2% observed). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 6').

examples.description: Freeze a moment as a 30 Hz gravel drone.
examples.expected_use: Sustains the sound around t=0.8 with a 30 Hz zigzag fundamental; locrand 0.1 thickens without losing the moment.

examples.description: Slow scrub through the whole file.
examples.expected_use: Write loc_ramp.brk '0 0 / 12 <indur>' (output-time axis) via breakpoint(); the head sweeps audibly back and forth while drifting through the source.

known_issues: Randomisation is FIXED-SEQUENCE: frqrand/locrand outputs are real but every run renders byte-identically (verified 1.3 s apart) - no seed slot, no clock path (osbind drand48 shim from an unseeded rand()). There is no way to get variants from the same settings; nudge a parameter instead. version_sensitive: a build that seeds rand() would change these renders.
Duration overshoots dur by up to ~1.2% (zigzag completes its cycle); frqrand also perturbs the final length by a similar order.
splice's ceiling depends on the MAXIMUM frq used (including breakpoint maxima): 1/(2*frq) seconds, refused verbatim otherwise.
MONO ONLY (verbatim). Breakpoint time axis is OUTPUT time (banner-confirmed).
frq below ~20 Hz reads as scrubbing (audible sweeps), above as pitch - the transition region (5-20 Hz) flutters.
